components.conjecture: Makes a prose working answer available to criticism and later use. Holds fixed the exact problem text, declared conjecturer endpoint and completion ceiling; statements remain fallible working claims.
components.criticism: Makes explicit objections available, each naming the claim or consequence it would defeat. Holds fixed the current working answer and exact problem; criticism remains fallible and may return an empty list. Two separate Qwen and GLM critics receive the same answer, and both differ in lineage from the DeepSeek conjecturer; this provides an explicit multi-family fork. Critics receive prior objections with dispositions and the rival when present; each objection must name a specific claim or step and checkable evidence or derivation that would show it wrong, rather than merely request caveats.
components.return: Delivers every open objection verbatim to the conjecturer input. Holds fixed objection identity and requires taken-up, rejected-with-reason or unresolved with an explanation for every delivered objection; earlier answers remain preserved.
components.use: Pose a concrete question depending on the working answer. Derive its answer from the problem alone with a public derivation, then separately from the working answer. Raise an objection if they disagree or the working answer cannot decide. Both derivations remain fallible; this is not an independent correctness certificate.
components.stop: Ends at the requested cycle count with cycle_budget, or when the current critic supplies no new objection and use raises none and no unresolved objection remains with no_new_objections. Holds fixed these mechanical stopping conditions; neither establishes correctness.
components.baseline: When requested, runs the exact problem once bare on the conjecturer endpoint and once with native thinking when an explicit control is available. Holds the completion ceiling at 8192 for both; all outputs are retained for reading without a computed comparison. Extra loop calls remain a resource difference.
components.scheduling: Runs dependency-ready roles sequentially for transparent personal use. Holds causal order conjecture, optional rival, critics, return and use; it makes no claim from historical wave scheduling.
components.rival: Makes one Kimi alternative answer available before criticism and return in each cycle. Holds fixed the exact problem and previous working answer; the alternative is a fallible candidate, with no automatic preference.
components.thinking: Each seat declares native, off or gateway-default. All shipped direct DeepSeek seats use native thinking; Ollama seats declare gateway-default because this transport has no explicit thinking control. Return reuses the conjecture seat setting. Bare baseline overrides off; native baseline overrides native when supported. Hidden reasoning is never persisted.

name: cross-family-rival
limitations: Personal composition is not a finding from a matched study.
Ollama registry native means transport, not evidence of a thinking toggle.
